detailed_description:
The target video is a living two-color risograph print in <Subject 1>: every shape keeps its orange and blue ink grain, hatching and slight misregistration as it moves, like animated screen-printed frames.
[Shot 1] The shot begins from <Picture 1>. The worn sneaker steps over the painted border line and lifts away out of frame, splashing a puddle. The camera follows the step forward over the line and rises slowly in one continuous move, gliding low along the wet street toward an orange glow ahead. Bass shakes the puddles. Silhouettes of dancers rise into the frame from below and their hands go up one after another until the crowd fills the lower half, and a blinding white burst of stage light flares in the center above them. The camera is still rising and pushing forward as the shot ends on <Picture 2>. No cut or transition occurs.
